name: bloom
title: Bloom
description: A flower head laid out by Vogel's model, drawn face-on as SVG: a marigold (zendu) first. Floret i sits at i times the golden angle and a radius of root i, so the head is evenly dense with no grid and no overlap, and adding a floret never moves the ones already placed. That lets a count be drawn honestly (37 people, 37 florets, and the number in text beside it), a head grow one floret at a time, and every name have its own flower (seed-from). Quiet is single-ink dots, still. Warm is the zendu palette, ruffled petals lit from the upper left, still. Playful grows from the heart outward in CSS (sibling-index() with a --i fallback) and shivers its outer ring when pressed. Reduced motion and Save-Data show the finished head. Draws at most 400 florets. Works under a strict Content-Security-Policy.

budget.reason: A component (0005, 0009): element 3.9 KB, pure core 9 KB (the layout, the zendu palette and petal, the words for assistive technology), the head builder 8 KB, three one-line skins. 22,011 B measured. The layout itself is the engine's phyllotaxis.js and is counted there. No frame loop: growth and the shiver are CSS animations the browser runs.

motif.gloss: The zendu, the orange and saffron marigold of every Indian flower seller's tray and market, drawn as a flower and nothing more: never placed with deity imagery or framed as a puja element.
